title: Sword of Life Stealing

sources.title: Life Stealing Critical
markers: | description = On a [[Critical Hit]], the target takes an extra {{DamageText|10|Necrotic|drs=t}} damage as long as it isn't a construct or an undead. You also gain {{Temp hp|10}}.

summary: +2 shortsword deals extra Necrotic damage on critical hits.

fields.Weapon profile: Martial, One-handed, 5 ft melee, Finesse, Light, Dippable. 1d6 + 2 Piercing plus Strength or Dexterity. +2 to attack rolls.
fields.Life Stealing Critical: A critical hit deals +10 Necrotic against targets other than Constructs or Undead. The effect grants 10 temporary HP. This is temporary HP, not direct healing.
fields.Piercing Strike: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Action, weapon damage. CON save against weapon-action DC +2 or Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Successful hits gain 2 Piercing. Honour Mode adds 2 of the original type to any damage source. Healing clears it. Undead and Constructs are immune.
fields.Flourish: With proficiency, once per Short Rest. Bonus Action, 1d4 nonlethal Bludgeoning. DEX save against weapon-action DC +2 or Off Balance for 2 turns, granting attackers Advantage and giving the target Disadvantage on STR/DEX checks. Damage or Help clears it.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
